units.source_text: 名人错下了92，忽左忽右地歪着脑袋。

en.t: The Master mishandled move 92, tilting his head now to the left, now to the right.

units.source_text: 经过一小时零九分的长考，白下94……

en.t: After a long think of one hour and nine minutes, White played 94...

units.source_text: 名人时而闭目养神，时而左顾右盼，

en.t: The Master would close his eyes to rest, then glance left and right,

units.source_text: 时而又强忍恶心似的耷拉下头，痛苦万状。

en.t: and then, as if fighting down nausea, let his head droop, looking utterly tormented.

units.source_text: 他一反常态，显出有气无力的样子。

en.t: He was entirely unlike himself, appearing weak and drained.

units.source_text: 也许这是在逆光下看名人的缘故吧，他的脸部轮廓朦胧松弛，仿佛是一个鬼魂。

en.t: Perhaps it was because I was seeing the Master against the light, but the outline of his face looked blurred and slack, as if he were a ghost.

units.source_text: 对局室里静谧得异乎寻常，95、96、97……不断在棋盘上落子的声音仿佛在空谷中回荡，十分骇人。

en.t: The playing room was unnaturally still, and the repeated sounds of stones being placed on the board, 95, 96, 97... seemed to echo through an empty valley, terribly frightening.
